stem: In the \(xy\)-plane, line \(\ell\) passes through the point \((-2, 5)\) and is perpendicular to the graph of \(3x - 2y = 7\). Line \(\ell\) crosses the \(x\)-axis at the point \((a, 0)\). What is the value of \(a\)?
solution: \(3x - 2y = 7\) has slope \(\frac{3}{2}\), so line \(\ell\) has slope \(-\frac{2}{3}\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
m0 = diff(solve(Eq(3*x - 2*y, 7), y)[0], x)
m = -1/m0
line = m*(x + 2) + 5
a = solve(line, x)[0]
assert a == Rational(11, 2)
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [a]
